headline: Meta spent $8,082 over 14 days with zero conversions, so I paused it. Direct growth lines up with AI-assistant mentions, not paid spend.

moves.reason: Zero conversions and $0 revenue for 14 straight days (since 10-18) on $8,082 spend; daily spend rose from ~$525 to ~$644. Self-reported 'Instagram or Facebook ad' also fell to 0% in the last 2 weeks, so it isn't only a tracking gap. Pause is cheap to reverse; restore after checking pixel/creative/account.

tests.hypothesis: Google search's last-click ROAS (7.4-7.6) overstates its incremental value; attribution models put it at 4.9 (first touch) to 9.7 (last touch), and CPA is up 30% since Oct 5 while direct and AI-referred buyers grew.
tests.design: Geo split holdout: pause or cut 50% of search spend in ~20% of matched regions for 3-4 weeks. Measure total conversions (all channels including direct) in held vs control regions, plus the self-reported 'Google' share. Brand and non-brand campaigns are split so we can see which one drives any drop.

tests.hypothesis: LinkedIn is above the 1.5 ROAS target under 4 of 5 models (1.88-2.49) but below it under last-touch (1.41), and its CPA is up 31% over 3 weeks. A holdout will show whether it is incremental.
tests.design: Pause LinkedIn for a random 50% of the target account list for 4 weeks. Compare total conversions and pipeline from held vs exposed accounts, including direct and untracked conversions.

flag_verdicts.reason: Meta had 0 conversions and $0 revenue from 10-18 to 10-31 on $8,082 spend, with daily spend rising from $526 to $644. Self-reported Instagram/Facebook share is also 0% in the last 2 weeks. Paused.

Direct conversions grew from 2.2 to 5.4/day while paid spend moved 1.02x. Self-reported AI answers ('AI assistant' plus 'Asked ChatGPT') rose from about 6% to 22-29%. This points to an untracked AI-referral source, not paid. No paid channel should get credit or budget for it. Direct has fallen from 43 to 31 conversions/week in the last 2 weeks, so keep watching.

flags.message: meta spent $8,082 over 14 days with zero conversions, and spend is still rising.
Direct conversions grew 2.4x (2.2 to 5.4/day) while paid spend moved 1.02x. Self-reported AI answers went from 7% to 22%. Something untracked is driving buyers.
